admin.translation.browser.defaultMessage: Permitir a tradução integrada do navegador
admin.translation.browser.description: Checkbox that enables the translation built into the reader's browser.

admin.translation.browser.description.defaultMessage: Traduzida no navegador de quem lê, quando ele tem este recurso, em qualquer visibilidade. Nada vai para este servidor nem para um provedor, e não conta nos limites.

admin.translation.limits.description.defaultMessage: Com 0, nada é enviado a um provedor. Não existe valor ilimitado: informe um número grande. Acima de um limite, o leitor é avisado e nenhum provedor é chamado.
admin.translation.limits.description.description: Explains the monthly limits of translation.

admin.translation.limits.server.defaultMessage: Caracteres por mês para todo o servidor
admin.translation.limits.server.description: Label of the monthly limit of characters of the whole server.

admin.translation.limits.title.description: Heading of the section with the monthly limits of translation and how long translations are kept.

admin.translation.limits.user.description: Label of the monthly limit of characters of one user.

admin.translation.move_down.description: Button that moves a translation provider later in the order of priority.

admin.translation.move_down_provider.description: Accessible name of the button that moves a translation provider later in the order: the button's text, then the provider.

admin.translation.move_up.description: Button that moves a translation provider earlier in the order of priority.

admin.translation.move_up_provider.description: Accessible name of the button that moves a translation provider earlier in the order: the button's text, then the provider.

admin.translation.number.invalid.defaultMessage: Informe um número inteiro de {min} a {max}.
admin.translation.number.invalid.description: Error of a number field of the translation settings.

admin.translation.number.range.description: Hint of a number field of the translation settings.

admin.translation.providers.none.descrip.defaultMessage: Um provedor precisa ser adicionado antes à implantação do servidor, com suas chaves na configuração. As chaves nunca aparecem nesta tela.
admin.translation.providers.none.descrip.description: Explains how a translation provider gets to the server.

admin.translation.providers.none.heading.defaultMessage: Nenhum provedor no lado do servidor neste servidor
admin.translation.providers.none.heading.description: Heading shown when the server has no translation provider to enable.

admin.translation.providers.privacy.defaultMessage: Atualize sua política de privacidade antes de ativar um provedor no lado do servidor. Quando alguém pede uma tradução, o texto da publicação vai para o provedor, inclusive o das publicações visíveis só neste servidor, e o texto enviado a um provedor não pode ser recolhido.
admin.translation.providers.privacy.description: Warning at the top of the translation providers: the privacy policy must change first.

admin.translation.providers.privacy.link.description: Link from the warning about the privacy policy to the screen of the documents.

admin.translation.providers.title.description: Heading of the section that enables translation providers.

admin.translation.reports.description: Checkbox that lets moderators translate reports with the server-side providers.

admin.translation.reports.description.defaultMessage: Assim, os moderadores podem traduzir as publicações de uma denúncia e o comentário de quem denunciou com os provedores acima. Cada provedor continua recebendo apenas as visibilidades marcadas para ele, e um comentário conta como uma publicação para seguidores. A tradução do comentário não é guardada, e os caracteres contam apenas no limite do servidor. A tradução integrada do navegador funciona nas denúncias de qualquer modo.
admin.translation.reports.description.description: Explains what sending reports to the translation providers does.

admin.translation.retention.description: Label of how many days a translation is kept.

admin.translation.save.description: Button that saves the translation settings.

admin.translation.save_failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível salvar as configurações de tradução: {reason}
admin.translation.save_failed.description: Shown beside the save button when the translation settings could not be saved; reason is the server's localized reason.

admin.translation.saved.defaultMessage: As configurações de tradução foram salvas.
admin.translation.saved.description: Shown beside the save button after the translation settings are saved.

admin.translation.settings.loading.description: Label of the spinner shown while the translation settings load.

admin.translation.summary.defaultMessage: Escolha quem traduz as publicações, o que cada provedor pode receber e os limites mensais.
admin.translation.summary.description: What the translation screen is for, in the menu of server administration.

admin.translation.title.description: Heading and menu entry of the screen with the settings of the translation of posts.

admin.translation.unchanged.description: Shown beside the save button of the translation settings when nothing was changed.

admin.translation.use.characters.description: Label of the number of characters sent to translation providers in a month. {month} is the month and year.

admin.translation.use.description.defaultMessage: Os caracteres são contados em meses UTC, sem as marcas que representam menções e links. Cada chamada a um provedor conta, inclusive as que falham, então o total pode diferir do que um provedor cobra.
admin.translation.use.description.description: Explains the number of characters sent to translation providers.

admin.translation.use.failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível carregar o uso deste mês
admin.translation.use.failed.description: Heading of the failure of loading the use of translation.

admin.translation.use.hit_rate.description: Label of the share of translation requests answered from a kept translation.

admin.translation.use.hit_rate.none.description: Shown as the cache hit rate before any translation request this month.

admin.translation.use.loading.description: Label of the spinner of the section with the use of translation.

admin.translation.use.retry.description: Button that loads the use of translation again.

admin.translation.use.title.description: Heading of the section with how translation was used in the current month.

admin.translation.visibilities.description: Legend of the visibilities of the posts that a translation provider may receive.

admin.translation.visibilities.descripti.defaultMessage: Permita Seguidores e Pessoas mencionadas apenas se a sua política de privacidade disser isso.
admin.translation.visibilities.descripti.description: Warning under the visibilities that a translation provider may receive.

admin.translation.visibility.direct.description: Checkbox: a translation provider may receive posts of this visibility, named as in the visibility picker.

admin.translation.visibility.local.description: Checkbox: a translation provider may receive posts of this visibility, named as in the visibility picker.

admin.translation.visibility.private.description: Checkbox: a translation provider may receive posts of this visibility, named as in the visibility picker.

admin.translation.visibility.public.description: Checkbox: a translation provider may receive posts of this visibility, named as in the visibility picker.

admin.translation.visibility.unlisted.description: Checkbox: a translation provider may receive posts of this visibility, named as in the visibility picker.
